message: Command `cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/kamailio/src; grep -rn "Content-Length\|content_length\|CONTENT_LENGTH" --include=*.c --include=*.h | grep -i "parse\|header" | head -40` executed with exit code 0.

message.content: This is Kamailio. The vulnerability is about Content-Length header parsing not considering multi-line header format, and missing safety checks for log messages when the message buffer is not being parsed. Let me look at the relevant source code.
